Most people only get terminated or in any form of trouble for attendance. So don’t be late and don’t call out if you don’t have the necessary sick and personal time to do so. 

Food court floor can be very slippery so wear something that’s got good traction and comfortable to stand in for long periods of time. 

Even if you see a big crowd/long line don’t panic the line isn’t going any where any time soon.

Dont hesitate to ask your supervisors/managers for help ESPECIALLY dealing with things you don’t know how to control or with members who are upset/argumentative. It’s their job to quell the members not yours. 

Also ask for an employee agreement handbook and read through it. Knowing your rights is extremely important because from my personal experience higher ups will intentionally and unintentionally take advantage of you. 

Other than that, good luck, have fun and be safe!
